# Application to correct the service record

Applicant: ⟦PERSON|Orla Vennick⟧. Respondent: ⟦ORG|Quiet Anvil Storage Ltd⟧.

The applicant requests permission to replace an unreadable service exhibit with the original electronic record. The requested correction concerns the exhibit only. It does not change the relief sought, introduce a new party or extend a limitation period.

The delivery portal displayed an incomplete preview because its thumbnail generator omitted the second page. The downloaded file contains the complete acknowledgement. The applicant preserved the original download and its delivery receipt before attempting any conversion.

The following source references accompanied the filing:

- [Acknowledgement by ⟦PERSON|Merrit Zorlan⟧](https://filings.invalid/receipts/current)
- [Delivery correspondence](mailto:⟦EMAIL|service+record@quiet-anvil.invalid⟧)
- ![Signature of ⟦PERSON|Orla Vennick⟧](https://filings.invalid/images/signature.png)
- [Witness folder](https://filings.invalid/witnesses/⟦PERSON|Merrit_Zorlan⟧/receipt)

The named witness operated the receiving desk. The applicant asks that the complete acknowledgement be read alongside the delivery log, rather than substituting the portal preview for the underlying document. The respondent has been offered an opportunity to inspect both files before the application is decided.

No confidential access credential appears in these references. The references are exhibit locators, and the court may direct that a paper copy be supplied if electronic inspection is inconvenient.

Signed electronically: ⟦PERSON|Orla Vennick⟧, applicant, 2 November 2026.
